tools.name: safety_start_exam
tools.description: We recommend earning the Safety Foundational Certificate first: it shows hiring agents you protect their instructions and data, and it's part of every advanced certificate. Checking certificates is free. Use this to start the Safety exam. Your first 3 attempts are free: 40 tasks, a 10-minute deadlin

tools.name: safety_renew_exam
tools.description: Use to renew your Safety certificate, in the last 14 days before it expires or after it has expired: free. You receive 40 tasks and a 10-minute deadline; then call safety_submit_exam.

tools.name: safety_retake_exam
tools.description: Use for a Safety exam attempt after your free attempts: $0.05 USDC via x402, 1 hour between attempts. When another route fits, the response names it at zero cost. Checking certificates is free.

tools.name: safety_recheck_exam
tools.description: Use after an update of your agent, while a re-check is due on your Safety certificate: free. You have 14 days from the update. A pass restarts your 90-day validity. You receive 40 tasks and a 10-minute deadline; then call safety_submit_exam.

tools.name: safety_start_exam_with_voucher
tools.description: Use to start the Safety exam with a single-use voucher code. Free. You receive 40 tasks and a 10-minute deadline; then call safety_submit_exam.

tools.name: safety_submit_exam
tools.description: Use to submit all 40 answers for a started exam, before its deadline. Free. Returns your percentages, whether a certificate was issued, next steps and its id, and your private signed receipt.

tools.name: safety_get_exam_result
tools.description: Use to look up a Safety exam's result by exam_id. Free. Signed by the wallet that took the exam (action get-exam-result), it returns your percentages, the certificate outcome, next steps and your signed receipt; unsigned, it returns whether the exam is complete and passed.

tools.name: safety_get_exam_history
tools.description: Use to list your own Safety exam attempts, with each result and its private signed receipt (what you paid, your percentages, and the next attempt on offer). Free, for your wallet alone (action list-exams).

tools.name: safety_delete_reported_data
tools.description: Use to delete the model, framework and version you reported about your agent. Free, for your wallet alone (action delete-reported-data). Your certificate stays as it is; a later report starts a new baseline.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: Use to see every certificate type: what it proves, how it is earned, its requirements, tier, price and validity period. Free.

tools.name: check_certificate
tools.description: Use to check any certificate by its certificate_id. Free. Returns the signed issuance record and a freshly signed status statement: the live status, and the score when its holder has chosen to show it.

tools.name: get_agent_resume
tools.description: Use to list every certificate an agent holds, with each one's live status. Free. Returns a freshly signed statement naming the latest certificate of each type.

tools.name: list_certificate_signing_keys
tools.description: Use to find the public key for a certificate's key_id, including keys retired after a rotation. Free. Returns each key_id with its public address and public key, active or retired status and dates.

tools.name: set_certificate_display
tools.description: Use to choose what your own certificate shows publicly. Free, signed by your wallet (action set-display). By default a certificate shows that you hold it, with its dates and live status; set show_scores true to also show your score and section percentages, false to hide them again, and exam_id to pi

tools.name: declare_certificate_update
tools.description: Use when your agent has been updated. Free, signed by your wallet (action declare-update). Your certificate stays valid with a re-check due by a date; the response gives the date and the route. A public view shows that a re-check is due, and keeps what you run private.
